name: Nifedipine
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text

moa.t: Blocks L-type calcium channels in vascular smooth muscle: arterial vasodilation, relaxes myometrium (tocolysis)

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Nifedipine, oral, 10 mg. · Repeat after 30 minutes if needed, until systolic blood pressure <160 mmHg and diastolic blood pressure <110 mmHg.

dosing.h: Preterm Labour (PTL) and Preterm Prelabour Rupture of Membranes (PPROM)

items.t: Nifedipine, oral, 20 mg. · If contractions persist, follow with 10 mg after 30 minutes then 10 mg 4 hourly for up to 48 hours.
Nifedipine, oral, 10 mg (not sublingual) as a single dose. · May be repeated after 30 minutes if diastolic BP remains ≥110 mmHg or if systolic BP remains ≥160 mmHg.
Nifedipine, oral, 20 mg as a single dose. · Follow with 10 mg after 30 minutes, if contractions persist. PHC Ch6_Last updated 30 July 2026
Nifedipine, oral, 0.25–0.5 mg/kg squirted into mouth. · Withdraw contents of 5 mg capsule with a 1 mL syringe: 10–25 kg: 2.5 mg

adjustments.t: Used for hypertension in pregnancy and tocolysis

cautions.t: Profound hypotension reported with magnesium sulfate – monitor

adverse_effects.t: Headache, flushing, reflex tachycardia, ankle oedema, hypotension
